body:
`person:group-videocon` · flag: **severe** · confidence: verified · tickers: VIDEOIND

Flag: SEVERE. Consumer-durables maker that diversified into oil & gas (Mozambique Rovuma stake, Brazil), DTH (d2h) and telecom with consortium bank debt of ~Rs 40,000 cr+ across 13+ group companies. Collapsed into insolvency (2018); the NCLT-approved Twin Star (Vedanta-group) plan for Videocon Industries (2021) implied a ~95%+ haircut and was later set aside by NCLAT -- outcome remains unresolved per this scan; listed shares effectively wiped out. ICICI Bank quid-pro-quo case: CBI FIR (2019) and chargesheet allege that ICICI's sanction of Videocon loans while Chanda Kochhar was CEO was linked to Dhoot's investment in NuPower Renewables (Deepak Kochhar's firm); CBI arrested the Kochhars and Dhoot (Dec-2022) -- the Bombay HC later held the Kochhars' arrest illegal (Feb-2024); the PMLA Appellate Tribunal (Jul-2025) upheld ED attachments, reportedly calling the Rs 64 cr transfer a bribe. Trial continues; no final criminal verdict found. ED also chargesheeted a UK-resident (Sachin Duggal) for alleged siphoning. Early signals: rising debt in unrelated ventures, complex cross-holdings, related-party flows, and a whistleblower (Arvind Gupta, 2016) letter. Lesson: when a consumer company's promoter bets on upstream oil with bank debt, minority equity is an option on that bet.

- **regulator findings:** PMLA Appellate Tribunal 2025 on attachments; criminal trial ongoing
- **red flags:** unrelated diversification on debt; whistleblower; lender-borrower conflicts

Sources:

| 27-Aug-2025 | Q3 FY25 | +5–7% | +14.3% | +8.3 pp |

| 3-Jun-2026 | Q2 FY26 | +7–9% | +14.1% | +6.1 pp |
| 2-Sep-2026 | Q3 FY26 | +8–10% | due ~early Dec-2026 | — |

- **Full-year comp guide path:**
  - FY25: +3–5% (Jun) → +5–7% (Aug) → +9.4–10.1% (Dec) → ~12.5% (Jan) → **12.8% actual**.
  - FY26: +3–5% (Mar) → +6–8% (Jun) → +10–12% (Sep).
- **EPS:** Q4 FY25 GAAP guide $3.34–3.52 → $4.28. Q1 FY26 adjusted $1.57–1.69 → $2.22. Q2 FY26 adjusted $1.17–1.29 → $1.68.
- **Reading:** two different credibility numbers. **Long-range targets were missed (65–84%)** under the prior team. **Near-term guides have been beaten 5 for 5, by 4–8 pp**, under the new CFO's method. The CFO calls the outlook "thoughtful", not conservative `[CC-Q2FY26]`.
- **Method lesson:** a promise tracker must **score long-range and near-term promises separately, and by management team.**

body:
**2026-11-23: worksheet v1.3, card v1.1, base rates v2 (lesson L34: every card so far said size 0).**
Goal: fix genuine model gaps without loosening the hurdle or any threshold.
- **Worksheet v1.3**
  - Optional cash tax (`cash_tax_rate` / `deferred_tax_share` / `cash_tax_rate_end`).
  - Reinvestment-realism check (`incremental_roic_5y` or `roic_history`; flags a gap of more than 5 pts, and solves the ROIIC the price implies).
  - An always-on **exit-multiple bet** table: exit P/E used vs DCF-consistent vs own median, and the EV of the 5-year multiple at each.
  - Regression: all 9 example and live inputs give identical numbers when the new inputs are absent.
- **Base rates v2** (`research_notes/Backtests/base_rates_5y.md`) from the survivorship-free stage-2 panels:
  - India ₹1,000–20,000 cr: P(≥3x) **21.3%** [14.1–28.7], P(≤0.5x) **11.3%** [7.0–16.1], P(blow-up) **15.4%** [10.2–21.4], n=208.
  - US float $0.5–10B: **7.0%** [6.0–8.1], **14.2%** [12.7–15.7], **10.9%** [9.6–12.3], n=3,125. Bounds under the other missing-price assumption: 9.8% / 19.9% / 15.3%.
  - The old classes are kept with a `_deprecated` suffix.
- **Card v1.1**
  - PEAD gate: India = bottom two quintiles (L19/L31). US = no gate (uncalibrated; quintile shown).
  - New outputs: base-rate CIs, a size-outside-class warning, and the v1.3 stage-5 lines.
- **Re-run of all 6 cards** (`tools/decision/calibration_2026-11-23/README.md`; no calls written): **all still size 0.**
  - The live cards are blocked only by EV vs hurdle.
  - Kirby's cash tax lifts the probability-weighted DCF from $58.6 to $70–84, but its EV only from 1.12x to 1.16–1.17x (hurdle 1.47x). The binding choice is the exit P/E: the card would clear only at its noisy own-median P/E of 21.5x.
  - Method lesson: every card's P(blow-up) is 0.07–0.18x the new base rate, so our scenario sets under-weight the left tail compared with the outside view.
